question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:

 UNYIELDING
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flexible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"unyielding"** means not giving way to pressure; hard or inflexible. It describes someone or something that is resolute and firm, not easily swayed or altered. (अडिग/अटल)
 
 
• **Example:** The leader remained unyielding in his decision despite opposition.
 
 
 
• **"Flexible"** refers to being capable of bending easily without breaking or being adaptable to different circumstances. (लचीला)
 
 
• **Example:** She has a flexible schedule, allowing her to accommodate last-minute changes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'unyielding'** is **'flexible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Flexible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stern** (सख्त): Strict, severe, or unrelenting in character or attitude.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher gave a stern warning to the latecomers.
 
 
 
• **Rigid** (कठोर): Unable to bend or be forced out of shape; not flexible.
 
 
• **Example:** The rules were so rigid that no one could adapt them to changing circumstances.
 
 
 
• **Stubborn** (जिद्दी): Having or showing dogged determination not to change one’s attitude or position on something.
 
 
• **Example:** His stubborn refusal to compromise made the negotiation difficult.
 
 

31:T62e,

The correct answer is option 1.
